name: Nathanael
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: Nathanael answered, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel. That is the title given him here, and it names one people.

note.label: John 1: The Word, the Witness of John, and the King of Israel
